mapper.select: SELECT 'SALES_CONTRACT' AS biz_type, id AS biz_id, contract_no AS display_name, updater AS deleted_by, update_time AS deleted_time FROM lunaerp_business_sales_contract WHERE deleted = 1 AND status = 'DRAFT' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_production_greige_order WHERE sales_contract_id = #{salesContractId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_production_dyeing_order WHERE sales_contract_id = #{salesContractId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_business_shipment WHERE sales_contract_id = #{salesContractId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_stock_in WHERE sales_contract_id = #{salesContractId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) )
